entities.summary: Christian Jalon Massinburg is an American professional basketball player for Pallacanestro Brescia of the Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He played college basketball for the Buffalo Bulls. He was named the 2019 Mid-American Conference Player of the Year. He previously played for the Long Island Nets of the NBA G League and Limoges CSP of the LNB Pro A.
